newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-HEYNCKES DISMISSES KOHLER SIGNING RUMOUR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HEYNCKES DISMISSES KOHLER SIGNING RUMOUR.

text.p: New Real Madrid coach Jupp Heynckes on Friday dismissed a newspaper report suggesting that he hoped to sign Borussia Dortmund's German international defender Juergen Kohler.
"He's a good player...but I believe that two Germans at Real are enough," said Heynckes, in an apparent reference to himself and goalkeeper Bodo Illgner.
Friday's edition of the Spanish sports daily 'Marca' said Heynckes had met Kohler to discuss a possible move to Real.
